helm_release.lb_ingress (the AWS Load Balancer Controller) waits for the IAM role and service account but not for aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.eks_role_policy. The controller assumes that role at runtime, so if the policy is not attached yet it starts without permissions to manage ALB/NLB. Add ordering on the policy attachment.

aws_cloudwatch_event_target.aws_node_termination_handler_rule_target references the SQS queue but not aws_sqs_queue_policy.aws_node_termination_handler_queue_policy. EventBridge can only deliver to the queue once the queue policy grants events.amazonaws.com SendMessage, so the target should be created after the queue policy.

kubernetes_service_account_v1.irsa sets metadata.namespace = var.kubernetes_namespace (a plain string) rather than the kubernetes_namespace_v1.irsa resource created by this module (create_kubernetes_namespace defaults to true for KEDA). The service account can be created before its namespace exists and fail; it should depend on the namespace.

kubernetes_service_account_v1.irsa sets metadata.namespace = var.kubernetes_namespace (a plain string) rather than referencing the kubernetes_namespace_v1.irsa resource that this module creates for the Prometheus IRSA.
